== Summary ==
[[Michael Pistone]] at the [[2008 Match Play Championship]], January 2008. Flickr caption by Nate Meeker: "Pistone + random walking in front" (the blurred person in front is not Pistone).

== Source ==
Photo by [[Nate Meeker]], Flickr: [https://www.flickr.com/photos/53301220@N00/2173899973/ DSCN0099 Pistone + random walking in front] (original image https://live.staticflickr.com/2179/2173899973_e13461f00a_b.jpg). Album linked in [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=254001#p254001 post by Meeker] (Nate Meeker), "Nate Meeker PICTURES!", Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, 7 January 2008, linking his Flickr album "MPC 2008 GG".
